openActions.title: Set a 4-hour first-review SLA for urgent/hotfix PRs
openActions.description: Slow review turnaround on urgent fixes (FB-0003) is blocking delivery. Agree that PRs labeled urgent or hotfix receive a first review within 4 business hours. Track weekly median time-to-first-review; target at least 90% within SLA for Sprint 5.

openActions.title: Enforce two-reviewer policy on main-branch PRs
openActions.description: The team identified an opportunity to strengthen review quality and throughput via consistent dual review (FB-0005). Require two approvals before merge for all PRs targeting main, with a documented exception for single-reviewer hotfixes.

reportExcerpt.themesSummary: Delivery reliability and incident response: The team reports stable production releases with no rollbacks, and a quick collective response when a customer escalation occurred. Code review throughput: Review turnaround is cited as too slow for urgent fixes, with a recurring suggestion to enforce a two-reviewer policy from prior retrospectives. Sprint planning efficiency: Planning sessions routinely exceed ninety minutes; the team suggests time-boxing and replacing in-meeting status updates with async notes.
